dedupe_keys.name: 국토교통부 공사중인 시설물 터널 목록 roads bridges and tunnels

description: 국토교통부_공사중인 시설물(터널) 목록 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 공사정보 및 현장번호, 시설물종류, 시설물명, 시점-종점, 터널상행선, 하행선, 터널 폭, 터널높이, 터널 굴삭 형식 등 제공. 본 데이터는 한국건설기술연구원이 관리하는 OpenAPI를 통해 제공되며 전국의 공사중인 터널 시설물에 관한 시공·구조적 현황을 집계한 자료이다. 본 자료는 건설사업 모니터링... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 공사정보, 터널정보, 시설물정보, 터널공사, 안전점검. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
